headline: Update reports from State Representative Josh Elliott and the chair, plus public input and correspondence.
summary: The agenda lists a public input session and a summary of recent correspondence. It also includes reports from ex-officio members and State Representative Josh Elliott, with an executive session only if the town attorney recommends one.
items: Update from municipal boards and commissions, with State Representative Josh Elliott
location: Hamden Government Center, First Floor Conference Room, 2750 Dixwell Avenue, Hamden, CT 06518, or via Zoom
item_action_words: There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted
UPDATE REPORT FROM THE FINANCE COMMISSION CHAIR
UPDATE REPORT FROM THE MUNICIPAL BOARD AND COMMISSIONS, INVITED GUEST

TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
FINANCE COMMISSION 
 
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA 
 
6:00 PM, DECEMBER 3, 2026 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 
Meeting Agenda: The Finance Commission, Town of Hamden, will hold a Regular 
Meeting on Thursday, December 3, 2026 at 6:00 PM via Zoom or in a hybrid format at 
the Hamden Government Center. First Floor Conference Room  
 
Please click the link below to join the webinar: https://hamden.zoom.us/j/86214001236 
Meeting ID: 862 1400 1236 
 
Dial In:  +1 646.558.8656 US (New York)  
Participants without Zoom access may still be able to join the meeting (in listen-only mode) 
by (1) dialing the above number and (2) enter the meeting ID: 862 1400 1236 (3) followed 
by #. 
   
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
 
2. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
 
3. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
 
4. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.  
5. REPORT FROM EX-OFFICIO MEMBERS 
 
  1. Public Official or municipal employee representing the Mayor, designated by the  
Mayor. 
  2. Representative of the Board of Education, designated by a majority vote of said 
Board. 
  3. Chair of the Legislative Council committee with jurisdiction over the budget, or a 
member  
of said committee designated by the Chair.
6. UPDATE REPORT FROM THE FINANCE COMMISSION CHAIR 
 
7. UPDATE REPORT FROM THE MUNICIPAL BOARD AND COMMISSIONS, INVITED 
GUEST 
 
 1. State Representative Josh Elliott, Connecticut General Assembly, 88th House District 
      
8. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney) 
9. REGULAR AGENDA 
 
10. UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
 
11. NEW BUSINESS 
 
12. ADJOURNMENT 
 
  
NOTE: The public may address any item on the agenda of a regular or special meeting and any 
matter within the purview of a Board or Commission at a regular meeting either electronically or 
in person, unless otherwise set forth or constrained by Law of the provisions of this Charter.
